name: Stack

examples.title: Basic Usage
examples.code:
<Stack>
  <Notification color="info">Your changes are saved.</Notification>
  <Box>A Box, with no margin to undo.</Box>
  <Card>
    <Card.Content>A Card, last.</Card.Content>
  </Card>
</Stack>

examples.title: Gap
examples.code:
<Group alignItems="flex-start" gap="6">
  <Stack gap="1">
    <Box p="3">gap="1"</Box>
    <Box p="3">gap="1"</Box>
  </Stack>
  <Stack gap="4">
    <Box p="3">gap="4"</Box>
    <Box p="3">gap="4"</Box>
  </Stack>
</Group>

examples.title: Forms
examples.code:
<Stack as="form" gap="1.5" aria-label="Profile">
  <Field label="Name">
    <Input placeholder="Ada Lovelace" />
  </Field>
  <Field label="Email">
    <Input type="email" placeholder="ada@example.com" />
  </Field>
  <Group justifyContent="flex-end" gap="1">
    <Button>Cancel</Button>
    <Button color="primary">Save</Button>
  </Group>
</Stack>

examples.title: Alignment
examples.code:
<Stack alignItems="flex-start" gap="2">
  <Button color="primary">Sized to its text</Button>
  <Button>So is this one</Button>
</Stack>

accessibility:
- **No role of its own:** a Stack adds nothing to the accessibility tree, apart from `role="list"`
  on a `ul` or `ol`, which Safari otherwise drops once Bulma's reset hides the markers.
- **Order:** it's always a column in the children's own order, so what's seen, the reading order
  and the Tab order agree.
- **Landmarks:** with `as="nav"`, `"aside"`, `"section"` or `"main"`, the Stack is the landmark. A
  `section` is a region only once it has a name, from `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.
- **Lists:** `as="ul"` or `as="ol"` with `li` children is announced as a list with its count.
summary: The `Stack` component lays its children out in a column, with Bulma's block spacing between them and their own block margins zeroed. A Stack of Boxes, Cards or Notifications looks like Bulma's own stacked blocks, spaced by the gap alone, so there are no margins to undo. A `gap` step replaces the default spacing. It's always a column, top to bottom.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render. With `ul` or `ol`, give it `li` children: it restates `role="list"`, which Bulma's list reset takes away in Safari.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between children, a step of Bulma's gap scale (`'2'` is 1rem). Unset, it's `--bulma-stack-gap`, Bulma's block spacing.

props.name: alignItems
props.description: How each child sits across the column. `'stretch'` makes each as wide as the Stack.

props.name: justifyContent
props.description: Where the children sit down the column, when it's taller than they are.

props.name: children
props.description: What it lays out, with `gap` between and their own Bulma block margins zeroed.

extraProps.name: ref
extraProps.description: Ref forwarded to the element `as` renders.

parts.catchAll: Remaining props of the element selected by as and Bulma helper props

types.name: BulmaGapStep
types.summary: A gap step as `gap`, `columnGap` and `rowGap` take it: a value from `validGaps`, or the same step written as a number (`gap={2}`, `gap={1.5}`). `Grid` took its gaps as numbers before the gap helpers were shared, so every gap prop still does.

types.name: LayoutElement
types.summary: The elements Stack, Group, Center and Flex can render as: Container's landmarks and sections, a list, a form or a fieldset.
